page /settings/account (the census lists settings.slugs, not this route); /settings/usage is allowed (:35) but no caller uses it

dynamic.reason: Automation.open: /automations?automationId=<id> (the path the app itself navigates to for its own new automation, /automations?automationMode=create, which this build's unified layout shows as its Scheduled page, /scheduled), or for a heartbeat the chat it watches, /local/<thread id> (the census sees the local thread route only relative to its parent)

unchecked: application menu items by nativeCommandId (applicationMenu.getSnapshot, invokeItem)
the app's command table, found by shape among the app's loaded modules (commands.cjs:12-40)

dynamic.reason: Command.run runs the app command the Command instance names (its id, args.commandId, any command of the app's table); it is sent to the page as run-command, so the only fixed mechanic is that message

unchecked: stored electron-persisted-atom-state: composer-prompt-drafts-v2 (composer.cjs:11,:21; not in the census' atom list)
the commands run only where a mounted composer handles them (area-kit runCommand)
git worker requests through openIn.requestGitWorker: stable-metadata, review-summary, apply-review-section-changes, branch-commits, cat-file, commit

dynamic.reason: the page path comes from the Host: /plugins/<plugin id> for Plugin.connect and disconnect (plugins.mjs:171), checked against /^\/plugins\/[^/]+$/ (plugins.cjs:13)

unchecked: action windows.tabs.open (File.open, Instructions.open, the tab of a ProjectAction's terminal)
electron postToWindow (navigate-to-route on the app's channel to its pages)
